after what happened at their 20th?

and it's always really moving and always makes them cry.

everyone cries and hugs him and pats him on the back,
and they all come up to me and say,

I wanna say thank you.
I know I probably don't say it enough, but...
I love you.

Was.

Okay?

uh, on behalf of my new bride, Rachel...
